title: ornithogalum angolense
intro: Ornithogalum angolense, commonly known as the Angolan Star Grass or Star Grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum angolense include its potential to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and treat respiratory infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
